intent.summary: Migrate the repository from legacy github.com/golang/protobuf (v1) APIs (proto, ptypes, jsonpb, ptypes/* well-known types) to google.golang.org/protobuf (proto, protoadapt, durationpb/timestamppb/anypb/wrapperspb/structpb, protojson). internal/status Status.WithDetails now takes protoadapt.MessageV1; encoding/proto codec, binarylog, pretty.ToJSON, xDS resource parsing, LRS load reporting and RLS config use v2 APIs; test/tools go.mod switched to protoc-gen-go from google.golang.org/protobuf. Must preserve runtime behavior and public API compatibility.
